notes.body: Should we retry connection errors too? A reset socket returns early at the `?` and never reaches this check.

notes.body: Good catch. I would rather keep this MR small and handle transport errors in a follow-up.

notes.body: This should honour `Retry-After` when the server sends it.

notes.body: Nit: a named constant for the `16` would explain the clamp.

notes.body: Benchmarks are flat on the happy path, retries only add latency when the server is unhealthy.
